math.projection_basis: Worst case assumes every enabled budget spends in full on every remaining day. Evidence case continues the observed last-7 calendar-day delivery rate. Neither is a forecast of leads, CPL, CPQL, revenue or profit.

changes.campaign: Search | NonBrand | HVAC Installation | Central MD | BOFU | 2026-08
changes.why: Best conversion volume in the account, but cooling-season installation demand falls through autumn. Settled September delivery is $45.44/day, so $55 still exceeds actual spend.

changes.campaign: Search | NonBrand | HVAC Repair | Central MD | BOFU | 2026-08
changes.why: Best CPA in the account ($277.53) and year-round repair demand. Protected: trimmed only $15 and still above its $17.92/day settled delivery.

changes.campaign: Search | NonBrand | AC Repair | Central MD | BOFU | 2026-08
changes.why: Cut first and deepest, as instructed. Worst measured economics in the account (CPA $637.65 August, $534.28 September) and the most expensive clicks ($106+ CPC in both windows), against falling autumn cooling demand. NOT eliminated - repair coverage is retained.

changes.campaign: Search | NonBrand | HVAC Replacement | Central MD | BOFU | 2026-08
changes.why: Zero September delivery and zero conversions in both windows. Small trim only; replacement jobs carry high ticket value and the campaign stays reachable.

changes.campaign: Search | NonBrand | Gas Boiler Repair | Central MD | BOFU | 2026-08
changes.why: INCREASE. This campaign becomes the boiler campaign and will carry two ad groups (existing Gas Boiler Repair plus the new Boiler Repair). Boiler clicks have historically cleared at $89.90-$106.03, so $12/day could never buy one.

changes.campaign: Search | NonBrand | Heating Installation | Central MD | BOFU | 2026-09
changes.why: INCREASE. Goes from one ad group to three (Mini Split, Oil Furnace Installation, Oil Heating System Replacement). $35 split three ways could not fund a single $25 mini-split click per day.

unchanged.campaign: Search | NonBrand | Heating Repair | Central MD | BOFU | 2026-09
unchanged.why: Unchanged. Still one ad group (Furnace Repair). Legacy Heating Repair is the best converting heating theme in the account: 35 conversions at CPA $339.37.

no_incremental_budget: Every dollar for heating comes from cooling reductions. Total account budget does not increase.
honest_limitation: These are ceilings, not spend predictions. Measured September delivery is $87.32/day averaged over 20 settled calendar days and $49.13/day over the last 7, against $237.00/day of enabled budget - the account is not spending what it already has. Impression share lost to BUDGET is 0.0-8.9% on four of the five enabled campaigns while share lost to RANK is 43.6-67.3%, so the binding constraint is the CPC bid ceiling, not the budget. Gas Boiler Repair is the single exception at 31.2% lost to budget. Reallocation is therefore a necessary guardrail and a correct architecture, but on its own it will not move delivery. No CPL, CPQL, lead-volume, revenue or profitability improvement is claimed.
